method: Read actual current script/article/pronunciation and compare against actual public-source reading record; run existing source preflight. No mathematical program, media rendering, audio listening or browser interaction in this report.

checks.name: source identity
checks.detail: R1 original lecture title and explicit course-site By credit preserved; R2 title/date and official collection author mapping preserved; 2003 source marked historical only.

checks.name: source quotation support
checks.detail: Both SourceQuote supports match the exact selected source fragments: R1 independence assumption; R2 23-person threshold. Translations and editor explanations are distinguished.

checks.name: article source links
checks.detail: Article includes R1 original and actual archived source URL, R2 solution URL and actual original question PDF.

checks.name: problem and model
checks.detail: Video and article state any pair, month/day rather than year, 365 uniform independent dates, ignore leap day, threshold strictly greater than one half.

checks.name: conditional product
checks.detail: Second/third/fourth/23rd factors consistently 364/365,363/365,362/365,343/365. The distinct-date illustration is conditional and not a forced birthday choice or random experiment.

checks.name: threshold and minimality
checks.detail: 22-person 47.57% and 23-person 50.73% are consistently rounded; monotonicity plus adjacent values supports minimum 23; probability is distinguished from guarantee.

checks.name: comparison boundaries
checks.detail: 253 pairs only intuitive/expected count; article rejects treating all pair events as mutually independent. Specified me uses 22 other people among 23 total and approximately 5.86%.

checks.name: scope and ending
checks.detail: Video keeps complement/product main line, no theorem tail, code card or proof call-to-action. Article includes complete formula, model limits and a main-line conclusion.

checks.name: reference source preflight
checks.detail: Executed node site/scripts/check-references.mjs --sources episodes/puzzles/birthday-paradox/production: passed for 2 sources. This validates recorded evidence/link structure, not source truth or final media.

checks.name: expected-pair count unit clarification
checks.detail: Writer revision inspected: 253/365≈0.6932, expected approximately 0.693 pairs, explicitly distinguished from 69.32% collision probability. Script unchanged.
